metric_contract.reward_normalization: sum of joint reward vector / (20 * n_SU); baseline scalar / 20, context only
metric_contract.smoothing: trailing arithmetic mean of 100 episodes; min_periods=100; first shown point episode 100; no padding or interpolation
metric_contract.seed_aggregation: equal-weight mean of each per-seed smoothed curve; faint lines retain each seed
metric_contract.final: mean of 100 greedy held-out audit episodes, then equal-weight training-seed means; random is the corresponding retained control
metric_contract.tail: mean of last 100 training episodes, not final audit
metric_contract.final_summary: vertical tick: seed mean; horizontal line: min–max across training seeds; x: random seed mean; no confidence interval
metric_contract.units: model reward per SU per slot; not physical throughput or energy efficiency
